findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

At the time of this inspection none of the employees have completed a Reporting Agreement or similar paperwork verifying their knowledge of their responsibility to report illnesses. The PIC had blank copies of the Sangamon County Reporting Agreement available and education was conducted. The PIC is instructed to make copies and have all employees sign one prior to the follow up.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

On arrival the hand sink next to the ice machine only has hand sanitizer available. The container was replaced during this inspection with soap to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

To-go containers and their lids are observed with the food contact surfaces face up/exposed next to the ovens. Education was conducted and the items flipped over to correct. Ensure that all single service food contact surfaces are stored so that the food contact surfaces are protected from contamination at all times.
